explanation: A part of the priestly garment consisting of a kind of vest, used by the high priest in ancient Israel.
A part of the priestly garment that was worn on the chest and contained twelve precious stones, one for each of the tribes of Israel.
Two objects placed in the breastpiece and used to seek divine guidance from God.
The supreme religious leader in ancient Israel, who performed special rituals and sacrifices.
The holy place where the Israelites worshiped God and carried out religious rituals.
A gift or act given to God to honor him, ask for forgiveness, or give thanks for blessings.
Special clothes worn by the high priest and other priests during religious ceremonies.
The twelve groups of descendants of Jacob's twelve sons, which made up ancient Israel.
